object.description: Specific object requested by the user.

parts.description: List of individual physical parts that make up the requested object. Each item represents one actual part, such as one leg, one wing, or one petal.

id.description: Unique identifier for this specific part instance. Distinguishes it from other parts with the same name (e.g. 'leg_1_L' vs 'leg_1_R').

length_weight.description: Normalized stick length of the part. The set of part lengths must describe a stick figure that fits within the unit square bounded by (0,0) and (1,1).

segment_index.description: Position of this part within a chained body sequence (1, 2, 3, ...), used only for objects whose body is split into multiple sticks to provide enough joints for many limb-pairs (e.g. an ant's body_1/body_2). Null for every part that is not a body segment.

symmetry.description: Optional metadata describing whether this part belongs to a mirrored or repeated group.

group.description: Identifier shared by mirrored parts belonging to the same repeated group (e.g. all legs share 'leg', all wings share 'wing').

side.description: Relative position of the part. Use 'left' or 'right' for bilateral pairs such as left/right legs or ears. Use 'center' specifically for flower petals, where petals form a radial arrangement rather than left/right pairs.

order_index.description: The repeated position index for this part. This is not the total number of parts. For bilateral limbs, each left/right pair shares one order_index. Example: 3 pairs of legs means 6 individual leg parts with order_index 1, 2, and 3.
